text.zh: 决赛加时，对手在你耳边不停挑衅你的家人……
text.en: Extra time in the final; an opponent keeps taunting your family in your ear…

label.zh: 转身一记头槌顶在他胸口，红牌离场——但你是真男人
label.en: Turn and headbutt him in the chest — sent off, but you're a real man

note.zh: 致敬齐达内 2006 世界杯决赛头槌

background.zh: 2006 年世界杯决赛，齐达内被马特拉齐挑衅后一记头槌将其顶倒，染红离场，也以这种方式告别了职业生涯。
background.en: In the 2006 final, Zidane headbutted Materazzi after a taunt, was sent off, and bowed out of his career that way.

label.zh: 微微一笑，转身用一记绝杀回敬他
label.en: Smile, turn, and answer with a winning goal

label.zh: 原地抱腿翻滚，演一出苦情戏，等他被罚下
label.en: Clutch your shin, roll around, milk it until he's booked

note.zh: 致敬内马尔 2018 世界杯翻滚
note.en: Neymar's rolling at the 2018 World Cup

background.zh: 内马尔在 2018 年世界杯多次夸张翻滚，催生了全球「内马尔滚」的模仿热潮。
background.en: Neymar's theatrical rolling at the 2018 World Cup spawned a global 'Neymar rolling' meme.

label.en: Tune it out and focus on the game
